liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Not Fade Away** (2 reviews): Reviewer says the Not Fade Away is blazing; The Not Fade Away, Goin' Down the Road, Not Fade Away sequence is the other standout jam [4][6]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): Truckin' flowing into The Other One is singled out as one of the show's two big jams [6]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Other One jam profound and incredible [13]
- **Ramble On Rose** (1 review): Ramble On Rose, following The Other One, is praised as part of an awesome three-song run [13]
- **Sugar Magnolia** (1 review): Sugar Magnolia completes the standout Other One, Ramble On Rose, Sugar Magnolia stretch, despite a weaker first set [13]

## The recordings

- **gd71-11-20.fm.willy.8806.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 24 songs; 157 min; rated 3.6/5 by 5 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the soundboard/FM sound quality quite poor, though the performance is energetic [4]
- **gd1971-11-20.sbd.miller.92908.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 24 songs; 147 min; rated 4.2/5 by 10 [2]. Said about its sound: The openings of Bertha and Cumberland Blues are missing a few notes; Reviewer hears studio-like clarity, with strong tone and instrument separation, apart from a few patches; Recording is stereo with a fine mix, though not especially crisp [2][6][7][12]

## Around the show

- Band does a lot of talking between songs [4]
- A 13-year-old attendee sat on stage under the piano with a friend [5]
- The basketball court floor had plenty of room for dancing, with many girls twirling [5]
- Show felt more produced, with official vendors and promoter security; attendee reached the stage front [8]
- Per a Bob Heil interview, the Dead hired him for stage sound after Owsley's arrest and gear seizure [9]
- Reel labels the concert as New Riders of the Purple Sage plus Grateful Dead at Pauley Pavilion, UCLA [12]
- Attendee recalls Keith as still fairly new to the band at this time [5]
- Reviewer hears a band shifting direction compared with April 1971, in a tight, orchestrated performance [7]
- This show lacks Alligator, Lovelight and Pigpen, which the reviewer feels changes the band's recipe [7]
- Hollywood Palladium in August held about 4,000; Pauley Pavilion seats over 13,000, plus unseated floor space [8]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd71-11-20.fm.willy.8806.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Chain is soundboard to FM to reel to DAT to CDR, from Rick Martin, seeded to etree by Willy [1]
- **gd1971-11-20.sbd.miller.92908.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat (48k) [2]. Also: Taken from the band's vault soundboard rather than an FM broadcast; Rob Eaton lent the DATs; An announcer is audible, leading the reviewer to suspect a radio simulcast recording; Reel labeled with John Batchelder and KMET as recording engineer, edited by Alan Coltri [2][10][12]

## Art and photos

- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1971-11-20 Sat Pauley Pavilion, UCLA, Los Angeles, CA](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1431269379122/grateful-dead-1971-11-20-sat-pauley) [16]
- Poster by gocollect.com: [Grateful Dead UCLA Pauley Pavilion Handbill 1971 Value - GoCollect](https://gocollect.com/concert-poster/grateful-dead-ucla-pauley-pavilion-handbill-1971) [17]
- Fan art by Honateez: [Grateful Dead Daves Picks Vol 48 Pauley Pavilion UCLA Los Angeles CA 11-20-71 Home Decor Poster Canvas - Honateez](https://honateez.com/product/grateful-dead-daves-picks-vol-48-pauley-pavilion-ucla-los-angeles-ca-11-20-71-home-decor-poster-canvas/) [18]
- Poster by gravitystereo: [Grateful Dead - Live at the UCLA Pauley Pavillion ( 3 CD SET ) ( with The New Riders of the Purple Sage at UCLA Pauley P](https://gravitystereo.com/product/grateful-dead-live-at-the-ucla-pauley-pavillion-3-cd-set-with-the-new-riders-of-the-purple-sage-at-ucla-pauley-pavilion-november-20th-1971/) [19]
- Poster by gravitystereo: [Grateful Dead - Live at the UCLA Pauley Pavillion ( 3 CD SET ) ( with The New Riders of the Purple Sage at UCLA Pauley P](https://gravitystereo.com/product/grateful-dead-live-at-the-ucla-pauley-pavillion-3-cd-set-with-the-new-riders-of-the-purple-sage-at-ucla-pauley-pavilion-november-20th-1971/) [20]
